# nish:region

The `nish:region` builtin module: the globals of the same names, importable. Its members are declared in `runtime/nish.d.ts`; [the language reference](language.md#builtin-modules-nish) is the normative list.

```ts
import {
  Region,
  enter,
  enterWith,
  free,
  region,
  regionWith,
} from "nish:region";
```

<scalar-grid cols="2">

<scalar-card title="enter" icon="phosphor/regular/function" href="#enter">

`f(root)`, allocating in the region.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="enterWith" icon="phosphor/regular/function" href="#enterwith">

`f(root, arg)`, under `enter`'s rules; `f` may not keep or grow `arg`.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="free" icon="phosphor/regular/function" href="#free">

Give the region's memory back.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="region" icon="phosphor/regular/function" href="#region">

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="regionWith" icon="phosphor/regular/function" href="#regionwith">

`region` with one outside argument for `f`, which `f` may read but not keep.

</scalar-card>

<scalar-card title="Region" icon="phosphor/regular/cube" href="#region">

</scalar-card>

## enter

`f(root)`, allocating in the region. What `f` answers is a scalar or a handle.

```ts
function enter<T, R>(
  r: Region<T>,
  f: (root: T) => R,
): R
```

#### Parameters

<scalar-field name="r" type="Region&lt;T&gt;" required>
</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="f" type="(root: T) =&gt; R" required>

<scalar-field name="returns" type="R">
</scalar-field>

## enterWith

`f(root, arg)`, under `enter`'s rules; `f` may not keep or grow `arg`.

```ts
function enterWith<T, A, R>(
  r: Region<T>,
  arg: A,
  f: (root: T, arg: A) => R,
): R
```

#### Parameters

<scalar-field name="r" type="Region&lt;T&gt;" required>
</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="arg" type="A" required>

## free

Give the region's memory back. A freed handle used again stops the program.

```ts
function free<T>(r: Region<T>): void
```

#### Parameters

<scalar-field name="r" type="Region&lt;T&gt;" required>
</scalar-field>

## region

A new region whose root is what `f` answers; everything `f` allocates is in it.

```ts
function region<T>(f: () => T): Region<T>
```

#### Parameters

<scalar-field name="f" type="() =&gt; T" required>
</scalar-field>

#### Returns

<scalar-field name="returns" type="Region&lt;T&gt;">
</scalar-field>

## regionWith

`region` with one outside argument for `f`, which `f` may read but not keep.

```ts
function regionWith<A, T>(
  arg: A,
  f: (arg: A) => T,
): Region<T>
```

#### Parameters

<scalar-field name="arg" type="A" required>
</scalar-field>

<scalar-field name="f" type="(arg: A) =&gt; T" required>
</scalar-field>

#### Returns

<scalar-field name="returns" type="Region&lt;T&gt;">
</scalar-field>

## Region

A handle to a region whose root is a `T`: 64 bits, not a pointer.

```ts
class Region<T>
```
